_note: PROVISIONAL. These four groups are a conservative inference from 'pulmonary condition', not her doctor's instructions. Replace message_en and add groups from her actual medical advice before relying on this (plan Task 12 step 3).

rules.message_en: Contains an NSAID. NSAIDs can trigger breathing problems in some people with asthma and related conditions. Show this box to the pharmacist and ask whether acetaminophen (아세트아미노펜) is suitable for you.
Contains a decongestant, which can raise heart rate and blood pressure. Tell the pharmacist about your lung condition and any other medicines you take before using this.
rules.source: Korean product inserts for OTC cold remedies; standard decongestant cautions

rules.message_en: Contains a non-selective beta-blocker. These can narrow the airways, including in eye drops. Do not start this without asking your doctor or pharmacist about your lung condition.
rules.source: Standard contraindication guidance for non-selective beta-blockers in obstructive airway disease

rules.message_en: Contains a sedating antihistamine, which causes drowsiness and can thicken airway secretions. Ask the pharmacist whether a non-drowsy alternative would suit you better.
rules.source: Korean OTC antihistamine product inserts; standard first-generation antihistamine cautions
